# GithubSpy
> Maintainer intelligence and pull request turnaround analytics for public GitHub repositories.

GithubSpy is a privacy-first web application enabling developers, applicants, and open-source contenders to analyze repository health, maintainer responsiveness, review turnaround velocity, and active contributors before submitting contributions.

## Core Capabilities
- In-depth telemetry on PR merge pace, resolution times, and review backlogs
- Complete all-time contributor rosters with accurate commit/PR metrics
- Applicant Feasibility Index (AFI) classifying project responsiveness
- Atomic single-request GraphQL engine with multi-tier client-side caching
- Zero tracking, 100% client-side execution, protected under SPSL-1.0
